thinking:
因子是单季度净利润的 SUE（Standardized Unexpected Earnings）。标准定义为：（当期净利润 − 去年同期净利润 − 历史季度环比差分均值）/ 历史季度环比差分标准差。用户描述里遗漏了“当期净利润 −”，这里按标准 SUE 修正。

具体实现：通过 `get_factor` 拉取 `net_profit_mrq_0` 到 `net_profit_mrq_7`（共 8 个季度单季度净利润），先算出 7 个相邻季度环比差分 `d_i = mrq_i − mrq_{i+1}`；再用 `row_aggregate` 分别求这 7 个差分的行向均值 `diff_mean` 与样本标准差 `diff_std`；最后代入公式 `(mrq_0 − mrq_4 − diff_mean) / diff_std` 得到因子值。

方向为 +1：SUE 越高代表盈利超预期程度越大，景气度上行，预期收益越高。
yaml_text:
factor:
  name: npf_mrq_sue8
  name_cn: "单季度净利润 SUE8"
  category: 景气
  direction: 1
  column: npf_mrq_sue8
  description: >
    过去 8 个季度单季度净利润的环比差分均值与标准差构建的 SUE 因子。
    公式：(net_profit_mrq_0 - net_profit_mrq_4 - diff_mean) / diff_std。

universe:
  primary_index: ALL

calculation_steps:
  - name: 获取过去8个季度单季度净利润
    action: fetch
    api: get_factor
    fields: [net_profit_mrq_0, net_profit_mrq_1, net_profit_mrq_2, net_profit_mrq_3, net_profit_mrq_4, net_profit_mrq_5, net_profit_mrq_6, net_profit_mrq_7]
    output_columns:
      net_profit_mrq_0: net_profit_mrq_0
      net_profit_mrq_1: net_profit_mrq_1
      net_profit_mrq_2: net_profit_mrq_2
      net_profit_mrq_3: net_profit_mrq_3
      net_profit_mrq_4: net_profit_mrq_4
      net_profit_mrq_5: net_profit_mrq_5
      net_profit_mrq_6: net_profit_mrq_6
      net_profit_mrq_7: net_profit_mrq_7

  - name: 计算环比差分 d_01
    action: compute
    formula: net_profit_mrq_0 - net_profit_mrq_1
    source_columns: [net_profit_mrq_0, net_profit_mrq_1]
    output_column: d_01

  - name: 计算环比差分 d_12
    action: compute
    formula: net_profit_mrq_1 - net_profit_mrq_2
    source_columns: [net_profit_mrq_1, net_profit_mrq_2]
    output_column: d_12

  - name: 计算环比差分 d_23
    action: compute
    formula: net_profit_mrq_2 - net_profit_mrq_3
    source_columns: [net_profit_mrq_2, net_profit_mrq_3]
    output_column: d_23

  - name: 计算环比差分 d_34
    action: compute
    formula: net_profit_mrq_3 - net_profit_mrq_4
    source_columns: [net_profit_mrq_3, net_profit_mrq_4]
    output_column: d_34

  - name: 计算环比差分 d_45
    action: compute
    formula: net_profit_mrq_4 - net_profit_mrq_5
    source_columns: [net_profit_mrq_4, net_profit_mrq_5]
    output_column: d_45

  - name: 计算环比差分 d_56
    action: compute
    formula: net_profit_mrq_5 - net_profit_mrq_6
    source_columns: [net_profit_mrq_5, net_profit_mrq_6]
    output_column: d_56

  - name: 计算环比差分 d_67
    action: compute
    formula: net_profit_mrq_6 - net_profit_mrq_7
    source_columns: [net_profit_mrq_6, net_profit_mrq_7]
    output_column: d_67

  - name: 计算差分均值
    action: row_aggregate
    source_columns: [d_01, d_12, d_23, d_34, d_45, d_56, d_67]
    output_column: diff_mean
    agg: mean

  - name: 计算差分标准差
    action: row_aggregate
    source_columns: [d_01, d_12, d_23, d_34, d_45, d_56, d_67]
    output_column: diff_std
    agg: std
    ddof: 1

  - name: 计算 SUE8
    action: compute
    formula: (net_profit_mrq_0 - net_profit_mrq_4 - diff_mean) / diff_std
    source_columns: [net_profit_mrq_0, net_profit_mrq_4, diff_mean, diff_std]
    output_column: npf_mrq_sue8
